title: Korean idiom quiz 🪰🐸🐱 "flying flies" means NO customers?! Guess all 3 in 3 seconds #learnkorean
caption:
Can you guess these 3 Korean animal idioms in 3 seconds? 🪰🐸🐱

파리 날리다 — not “flying flies”: a shop with no customers
우물 안 개구리 — not just “a frog in a well”: someone who only knows a tiny world
고양이 세수하듯 — not “washing like a cat”: a quick splash instead of a real wash

Say it: 파리만 날려요 · 우물 안 개구리였어요 · 고양이 세수만 했어요

How many did you get? Comment your score 0/3 – 3/3 👇

alt: Felt mascot Mongle hosts a Korean idiom quiz. Felt flies flown on strings like kites, a frog sitting on a stone well and an orange cat washing its face with its paw show the literal readings of 파리 날리다, 우물 안 개구리 and 고양이 세수하듯; a bored bear in an empty shop, the frog with a backpack gazing at a globe, and a sleepy bear splashing a little water at a sink show the real meanings.
